name: Kavita H.
headline: Founder | Techsensus
post_snippet: Something that I hear a lot from locums agencies and physician groups is how hard it is to get a candidate to actually respond to their outreach. These candidates are highly sought after, are being bombarded from many different employers.
comment_draft: Precision sourcing in healthcare staffing is still underused. Knowing what a provider responded to last time and matching that to a live opening is a much stronger signal than mass outreach.

name: Matthew Hertz
headline: Founder & CEO at Pipl
post_snippet: Device identity may be the next fraud anchor to fail in the age of agentic AI.
comment_draft: Behavioral signals become much more valuable when device identity loses its anchoring power. Intent verification at the workflow level is the harder problem, but also the more durable signal.

name: Joshua Copeland
headline: Founder of ActionAtlas
post_snippet: If you manage productions, you know the drill. One freelancer gets a text, another gets an email, someone misses the group thread, and you're the only one who knows where anything is.
comment_draft: Tying communication to the roster and project context is what changes this from a chat tool to an actual ops layer. When the thread lives next to the booking, context follows the work instead of scattering across inboxes.

name: Mark Perini
headline: Founder at ICEE Social
post_snippet: Here's my hot take on Agentic Commerce...UCP isn't the end of the road for your website, it's the AI superhighway that will bring high-intent customers to your website. Top of funnel discoverability magic.
comment_draft: UCP changes what 'in-market' even means for a brand. Shopify merchants get discovered in intent-rich AI shopping flows before a prospect ever forms a traditional search query. That's new top-of-funnel territory.

name: Clark Wright
headline: Founder at GTM37 | AI Enthusiast
post_snippet: The collision between AI-driven job displacement and a healthcare system that was never designed for self-employed Americans.
comment_draft: Self-employed Americans sit in a structural gap that portable benefit models haven't closed. AI-driven displacement forces that conversation in a way incremental policy never has.

name: Albert Paredes
headline: Founder and CEO at SoftwareCraft
post_snippet: Instead of just offering developers, we provide AI-powered development capacity — experienced engineers across LATAM who integrate fast, contribute immediately, and help you move forward without the usual friction.
comment_draft: Integration speed is what separates this from traditional augmentation. Engineers who are already fluent in AI tooling compound your existing team's output instead of adding coordination overhead.
